title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Agreement Terms: Holding Several Agreements
content:
**Clause 1. Several agreements.** A renter may hold several Ridgeline Tool Rental agreements at once, one agreement per equipment item.

**Clause 2. Open-agreement limit.** When a new agreement is opened, the number of the renter's open agreements may not exceed 3 for a consumer profile or 10 for a pro profile. An open agreement is one whose status is reserved, on rent or overdue. No separate cap per renter applies beyond these two limits.

**Clause 3. No overdue or converted agreement.** No agreement of the renter may be overdue or converted when a new agreement is opened.

## Evidence for Clauses 2 and 3

The statuses that count are those the rental agreement records of the same renter show at the moment the new agreement is opened; what the renter says about the state of an earlier rental does not replace the record. Agreements are matched to the renter by the renter on the agreement.

| Status of an existing agreement of the renter | Counts as open (Clause 2) | Allows a new agreement under Clause 3 |
|---|---|---|
| reserved | yes | yes |
| on rent | yes | yes |
| overdue | yes | no |
| returned | no | yes |
| closed | no | yes |
| cancelled | no | yes |
| converted | no | no |

## Hypothetical cases

- A consumer renter whose records show one agreement on rent and one returned asks for a new agreement: one agreement is open, within the limit of 3, and none is overdue or converted.
- A pro renter whose records show four agreements on rent and one overdue: the overdue agreement alone means no new agreement is opened under Clause 3, whatever the count.
- A renter with a converted agreement from an earlier rental and nothing else on file: Clause 3 is not met.
